metadata.description: ReproAI Prep — prepare a replication package for reproducibility checks and certification.

plugins.name: reproai
plugins.description: Prepare a replication package for a journal's reproducibility check or a certification service such as IQSS Certify: a static check against an author rule set and a venue or certification profile (never runs author code), approved repairs on a copy, an optional rehearsal that runs a copy twice, and a handoff. Never issues a verdict or a certificate.
